thread:
maria: CI red on PR #4122 after merging feature/opt-serve. Pyright errors + rustfmt diffs showing up in the same run. Anyone hit this locally? :eyes:

alex: what's the pyright output? paste a snippet?

maria: paste below — I only see this on CI, not in my dev env.

```
/checkout/redwood/inference/serve/api.py:42: error: Item "None" of "Optional[Mapping[str, Any]]" has no attribute "get"  [attr-defined]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 120 source files)
```

jay: hm that looks like a new optional introduced in the last commit. Did you re-run stubs generation?

maria: I didn't. I only touched request routing. Also rustfmt shows a bunch of format diffs in the worker crate — weird.

sam: could be a toolchain drift — rustfmt or pyright version mismatch between CI image and local dev. Can you run `make typecheck` and `rustup show` locally?

maria: ran `make typecheck` — passes locally. `rustup show` is stable-x86_64. CI says rustfmt 1.65.0 though.

alex: let's try a CI rerun of the failing shard; if it flakes we can bisect. @ci-bot can you rerun job build/7892 (shard typecheck+format)?

lee: I queued it: @ci-bot rerun build/7892 (from PR 4122). :fast_forward:

ci-bot: Rerun queued by lee. New job id: build/7921. Started at 2024-06-13T15:24:12Z.

sam: while that runs, quick local check — add an explicit Optional guard around the mapping access to silence pyright for now e.g. `if headers is None: headers = {}` then keep investigating.

jay: good short-term fix. For rustfmt, try `rustup component add rustfmt` and `cargo fmt --all -- --check` to reproduce. CI image might have different installed toolchain.

maria: thanks — pushing a tiny patch to add the guard and formatting. Will update.

ci-bot: build/7921 finished: failed (typecheck errors). Log excerpt: "Found 1 error in /checkout/redwood/inference/serve/api.py".

alex: still failing — looks deterministic now. Sam, can you bisect the range between the last green and this PR? quick bisect script: `./tools/ci/bisect-typecheck --start=origin/main~10 --end=PR/4122`

sam: running bisect now, will post earliest bad commit.

(10m later)

sam: bisect results: first bad commit is `c4f9b2a` — it introduced a refactor of request headers returning Optional[Mapping]. I can open a tiny follow-up to reintroduce safe access.

maria: ack — I'll add the fix in a follow-up and reference `c4f9b2a`. Thanks all.

alex: great. once the fix is up, request another CI run and if green we can merge. :thumbsup:
